execution.note: Author-only execution split honored; regression tests were added but not executed.

findings.root_cause: The always-mounted cloud transcript-share routes depended on shared_transcripts and share_audit_log, but their Postgres DDL appeared after the agentExecutionEnabled=false early return.

fix.summary: Moved production-owned share/audit DDL, indexes, retention constraint repair, and guards before the role gate. Kept #1219 agent-memory DDL gated because it is an agent-execution projection.

tests_added: apps/api_server/src/__tests__/phase6_sharing_postgres_bootstrap.test.ts — asserts the cloud-role DDL set includes both share tables and excludes gated agent-memory DDL.

findings.root_cause: Share creation sanitized caller-supplied categories and content directly, allowing a protected persisted part to be mislabeled as a normal message.

fix.summary: Loads persisted transcript messages, derives category from role/part type/tool identity/attachment flags, snapshots persisted content, and uses caller review entries only as requested item IDs.

tests_added: apps/api_server/src/__tests__/issue_1178_transcript_sharing.test.ts:204 — proves system-prompt misclassification remains excluded and caller content is ignored.

findings.root_cause: The sanitizer pattern set omitted multiple common credential, cookie, connection-string, and host-path forms.

fix.summary: Added PEM, JWT, AWS AKIA/ASIA, Google AIza, cookie, Postgres/MySQL/MongoDB URI, bearer authorization, macOS path, and Linux path redaction coverage.

tests_added: apps/api_server/src/services/transcript_share_sanitizer.test.ts — table-driven redaction cases for every requested pattern family.

findings.root_cause: Recipient validation proved only that user IDs existed; it did not establish a common organization/workspace with the source owner.

fix.summary: Requires every recipient to share at least one workspace with the source owner and returns 403 when the boundary is absent or cannot be established.

tests_added: apps/api_server/src/__tests__/issue_1178_transcript_sharing.test.ts:244 — asserts a cross-workspace recipient receives HTTP 403.

findings.root_cause: Snapshot immutability and audit retention relied on repository behavior, while database users could update snapshot_json or delete/cascade-delete audit rows.

fix.summary: Added SQLite/Postgres snapshot-update and audit-delete rejection triggers, removed the audit-to-share cascading FK, and preserved the existing soft-revoke path.

tests_added: apps/api_server/src/__tests__/issue_1178_transcript_sharing.test.ts:262 — direct SQL update/delete attempts fail and audit history survives direct share-row deletion.

findings.root_cause: Memory ledger rows had no database append-only enforcement, Postgres selected the previous entry separately from insert, and rollback_target had no same-source integrity guard.

fix.summary: Added SQLite/Postgres append-only and same-source rollback-target triggers and replaced read-then-insert with a single INSERT ... SELECT in both repository paths.

tests_added: apps/api_server/src/contract/issue_1219_memory_provenance.test.ts:234 — a rollback target from another memory_source_id is rejected.
